reviews.disposition: Retain one purse, qualified quote basis, derived service/referral totals and refusal/unknown-fee distinction. Native proof used a scratch 8-pence/net-7 assumed act, not Anna’s later stated transaction or a shipped row. KJ3AA subsequently proves its 12-pence payment, while C1 supplies the deferred 1.5 share plus 0.5 tip model with separate reachability gaps. Full floor was not met by “except rules”; headless scratch and export/reload are their own proof, unknown/refusal paths were source-tested only. reviews.classification: historical mechanism delivery evidence with explicit native and consumer limits
reviews.disposition: Retain exact halfpenny grain and change conservation at the one purse, default-off behavior elsewhere and denomination versus exchange distinction. The headless runner is an in-process DOM, not rendered Chrome; serializer/button-path evidence does not establish desktop pixels or a combined actual exchange/bank route. Rounding fees upward/nonzero and credits downward are proposed policies, not canon numeric laws inferred from coin size. Source-stated fees and payment terms still govern. Whole-number unchanged loading is narrow compatibility evidence, not all downstream money consumers. Current rules PASS does not retroactively make this old candidate meet all gates.
